risks.text: No implementation-review report, test log or manual browser check report was found for this feature; the written spec's explicit owner approval is not recorded (status: awaiting owner review).
Spec limitation: a photo backdrop cannot be contrast-checked, and gradient backdrops are checked only at their colour stops.
Later work changed related parts: the root font scale became 100vw / 80 and the grid 24 columns; the header and board layout changed with edit mode, widget runtime and confirmation features.

decisions.text: A theme is a record {id, name, mode, skin, css} whose CSS is exactly one rule holding color-scheme and contract tokens (--ld-*, colours as oklch literals or var() references to colour tokens); structure and effects live only in trusted built-in skins. Token-only CSS cannot hide controls, bypass contrast or reach another theme's widgets. A recipe+compiler approach was approved first and dropped because without an editor the derivation has no consumer.

Contrast is enforced by the validator against a WCAG 2 matrix in two modes (translucent surface-1 over bg and backdrop stops, and solid with surface-1-solid); only surface-1 may be translucent; surface-1-solid must be an oklch literal. Own oklch math is used instead of a colour library.

CSS is delivered only as files, never by runtime <style> injection, so Tauri's nonce-based style-src does not break it. Cascade layers order ld.reset, ld.frame, ld.skin, ld.theme, ld.utilities, ld.widget, ld.comfort, so user comfort preferences beat widget CSS; the order is pinned by a build check.

Theme selection resolves through themeId chain (widget, room, workspace) with null inheriting and unknown ids treated as null with a warning; in the MVP only the workspace id exists, stored in localStorage key lifedashboard.appearance with never-throwing load/save, defaulting to builtin:glass.

Widget content is styled by UnoCSS (presetWind4, no preflight) with a replaced semantic colour vocabulary and a blocklist (arbitrary values, dark:, palette classes, fixed/z-index); class checking is built on the generator. New dependencies approved with the spec: unocss and @unocss/nuxt (exact 66.10.5) and postcss 8.5.28 as a devDependency.
